application_auth_admin_audit_actor_check.name: application_auth_admin_audit_actor_check
application_auth_admin_audit_actor_check.value: ("iam"."application_auth_admin_audit"."actor_type" IN ('platform_admin', 'external_service') AND "iam"."application_auth_admin_audit"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("iam"."application_auth_admin_audit"."actor_type" = 'anonymous' AND "iam"."application_auth_admin_audit"."actor_id" IS NULL)

application_oauth_client_secret_policy_c.name: application_oauth_client_secret_policy_check
application_oauth_client_secret_policy_c.value: ("iam"."application_oauth_client"."public" AND "iam"."application_oauth_client"."client_secret" IS NULL AND "iam"."application_oauth_client"."token_endpoint_auth_method" = 'none') OR (NOT "iam"."application_oauth_client"."public" AND "iam"."application_oauth_client"."client_secret" IS NOT NULL AND "iam"."application_oauth_client"."token_endpoint_auth_method" IN ('client_secret_basic', 'client_secret_post'))
